summary:
MarsWalk is an interactive 3D planetary exploration and Extravehicular Activity (EVA) planning platform engineered to assist future Mars astronauts and mission planners. Future human crews on Mars will operate under a 4 to 24-minute communication delay with Earth, strict suit oxygen and battery budgets, and extreme surface hazards. MarsWalk addresses these critical constraints by integrating NASA Mars Trek orbital cartography and regional elevation data into an intuitive web interface. 

Crews can analyze high-resolution 3D terrain, identify crucial in-situ resources (water ice, clay minerals, silica deposits), evaluate terrain slope and radiation risks, and preview traverses in an interactive first-person EVA simulation. The system features Ares, an intelligent, zero-persistence on-suit voice and text copilot operating in English and Brazilian Portuguese. MarsWalk bridges high-level mission planning and real-time surface safety, empowering autonomous decision-making when instant Earth support is impossible.
details:
What it does & How it works

MarsWalk is a comprehensive Martian EVA planner and surface exploration system designed for both strategic mission planning and operational astronaut assistance. The application is structured in three interconnected layers:

1. Planetary 3D Cartography: A global, interactive Mars globe rendered with NASA Mars Trek WMTS orbital tiles, showcasing scientifically validated landing sites (Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, Valles Marineris, Olympus Mons, Utopia Planitia, Meridiani Planum). It includes neighboring planets and starfields for celestial navigation orientation.

2. Regional Resource & Hazard Heatmaps: High-resolution local topographic overlays that map critical resources (water-ice deposits, clay minerals, volcanic basalt, silica) alongside terrain slope, dust traps, and radiation exposure zones.

3. First-Person Walk Simulation & Life Support Dynamics: A 3D Martian surface environment running at 0.38g gravity, featuring procedural regolith textures, real-time suit telemetry (O2 consumption, battery discharge, distance traveled), emergency base resupply hubs, and headlamp illumination.

4. Ares Support Companion: A zero-persistence mission assistant accessible via text and real-time bidirectional voice (supporting English and Portuguese), providing contextual EVA guidance without logging sensitive mission logs.

Benefits & Intended Impact

Human exploration of Mars cannot rely on real-time Earth intervention due to the 4 to 24-minute speed-of-light communication latency. MarsWalk directly addresses cognitive overload and mission autonomy by giving surface astronauts immediate, local situational awareness. By correlating terrain roughness with life-support burn rates, MarsWalk ensures crews select safe, scientifically valuable traverse routes, minimizing life-threatening suit exhaustion incidents.

Tools, Languages & Frameworks

- Frontend & Core Architecture: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Start (full-stack edge routing), Vite 7, and Tailwind CSS.

- 3D Graphics & Simulation: Three.js and React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei) with custom GLSL shaders and procedural heightmaps.

- Voice & AI Infrastructure: Lovable AI Gateway with streaming WebSockets and WebRTC for low-latency, bilingual audio dialogue.

- Data Integration: NASA Mars Trek REST/WMTS tile services and USGS/PDS MOLA elevation models.

- Desktop Packaging: Electron sandbox runner for offline field deployment.

Creativity & Factors Considered

The project uniquely unifies orbital remote sensing data with an immersive tactical simulation. We accounted for real-world environmental extremes: low atmospheric density, 38% Earth gravity, thermal day/night swings, communication blackouts, fine electrostatic dust, and the psychological necessity of clear, unencumbered HUD interfaces.
